feedback: can you make this game 3d visually without changing the game mechanics

selection.reason: To make the game visually 3D, we need to add the WEBGL parameter to createCanvas in setup, add lights and adjust the coordinate system in draw (WEBGL origin is at the center), and replace 2D drawing functions with 3D primitives (box, sphere) in drawEntities, without touching the 2D game mechanics.

patch.notes: Enabled WEBGL mode in setup. Adjusted drawEntities to apply a coordinate shift simulating the 2D plane offset, added 3D lighting, and replaced 2D shapes (rect/ellipse) with 3D counterparts (box/sphere).
